story_description: As a user, I want to configure which AI provider and model to use when creating a new session so that I can choose the best tool for my task and leverage different CLI backends.
task_description: Implement a provider picker with segmented control for Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google providers, plus a model list that updates dynamically based on selected provider, with CLI availability detection and tier badges.
atom_description: Create the ProviderModelSection SwiftUI component containing a segmented provider picker and a filterable model list with tier badges, CLI status indicators, and appropriate state management for the New Session Modal.
problem_statement: Users currently have no way to select which AI provider or model to use when creating a session. The app defaults to a single provider without giving users control over which CLI backend or model tier they want, limiting flexibility and user choice.
scope_in: Provider segmented picker with three options: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google
Model list filtered by selected provider with radio button selection
Tier badges on each model: flagship, balanced, fast
CLI availability indicator checking PATH for installed binaries
Default model auto-selection when provider changes
State binding to parent NewSessionModal for provider and modelId
scope_out: API key entry or management UI (handled by system keychain)
Model download or installation flow (defer to F005)
Token limit or context window display (future enhancement)
assumptions: AIProvider enum and Model struct exist from prior atoms
EngineManager can detect CLI availability via which command
CLI binaries follow standard naming: claude, codex, gemini
Model metadata including tiers is available as static data
constraints: Must use SwiftUI native controls for macOS look and feel
Segmented picker must be horizontally aligned
Model list must scroll if more than 5 models
CLI check must be async to avoid blocking UI thread
Component must work in sheet modal context
functional_requirements: FR-01: Selecting a provider segment updates the model list to show only models for that provider
FR-02: Each model row displays name, tier badge, and optional description
FR-03: Exactly one model can be selected at a time via radio button style
FR-04: Default model is auto-selected when provider changes based on provider default config
FR-05: CLI status badge shows green checkmark if CLI is in PATH, yellow warning if not installed
FR-06: Clicking not installed badge does not block session creation but shows tooltip about limited functionality
FR-07: Selected provider and modelId are bound to parent state for form submission
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR-02: Provider switch and model list update appears instantaneous with no visible loading state
NFR-03: Component renders correctly in both light and dark mode
NFR-04: Accessibility labels present on all interactive elements
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create AIProvider enum with cases anthropic, openai, google if not exists
Step 2: Create Model struct with id, name, provider, tier, description, isDefault fields
Step 3: Create static ModelRegistry with hardcoded model lists per provider
Step 4: Create ProviderModelSection view with @Binding for selectedProvider and selectedModelId
Step 5: Add Picker with segmented style for provider selection
Step 6: Add List or VStack with ForEach for model rows filtered by provider
Step 7: Create ModelRowView with radio button, name, tier badge, and description
Step 8: Add TierBadge view with color coding: flagship=purple, balanced=blue, fast=green
Step 9: Add CLIStatusBadge view with async CLI detection logic
Step 10: Wire onChange handler for provider to update model list and select default
Step 11: Add to NewSessionModal body between directory section and trust mode section
Step 12: Bind selectedProvider and selectedModelId to modal state properties
data_model_changes: Add AIProvider enum with rawValue String for CLI binary name lookup
Add Model struct with Identifiable, Hashable conformance
Add ModelRegistry static class with getModels(for provider: AIProvider) -> [Model]
Add ModelTier enum with cases flagship, balanced, fast
event_contracts: ProviderModelSection emits no events; state changes via Binding
Parent modal observes @State changes for form validation
ui_states: Idle: Provider picker shows Anthropic selected, model list shows Claude models, default selected
Provider Changed: Model list animates update to new provider models, new default selected
CLI Installed: Green checkmark badge next to provider segment
CLI Not Installed: Yellow warning badge with tooltip explaining install needed
Model Selected: Radio button filled for selected model, others empty
ui_interactions: Tap provider segment to switch providers and update model list
Tap model row to select that model for the session
Hover CLI badge to see tooltip with install instructions
Keyboard navigation: Tab moves between picker and list, arrow keys select models
ui_copy: CLI Not Installed - Session will use fallback
Most capable model for complex tasks
edge_cases: No CLIs installed: All providers show warning badges but selection still works
Provider with single model: List shows one item with no scrolling
Provider with many models: List scrolls, maintains selection on scroll
Rapid provider switching: Debounce or cancel prior async CLI checks
Dark mode: Tier badge colors remain distinguishable
failure_modes: CLI check times out: Default to unknown state with neutral badge
Model list is empty for provider: Show placeholder text No models available
State binding fails: Parent modal uses default values
Memory pressure: Static model registry is lightweight, no issue expected
rollback_plan: Remove ProviderModelSection from NewSessionModal body. Delete new files: ProviderModelSection.swift, ModelRowView.swift, TierBadge.swift, CLIStatusBadge.swift, ModelRegistry.swift. Revert AIProvider.swift and Model.swift if they only contain atoms changes. Session creation continues with hardcoded defaults.

unit: Test ModelRegistry.getModels returns correct models for each provider
Test ModelRegistry.getDefaultModel returns model with isDefault true
Test AIProvider rawValue matches expected CLI binary names
Test Model Hashable conformance for use in ForEach
integration: Test ProviderModelSection updates model list on provider change
Test ProviderModelSection selects default model on provider change
Test CLIStatusBadge async detection integrates with EngineManager
Test state binding propagates to parent NewSessionModal
ui: Verify segmented picker renders with three segments
Verify model list shows correct models per provider
Verify tier badges display with correct colors
Verify radio button selection is mutually exclusive
Verify dark mode renders all elements correctly
perf: Verify provider switch feels instantaneous with no dropped frames
Verify memory usage stays flat during rapid provider switching
security: Verify CLI detection uses Process spawn not shell injection
Verify no user input is interpolated into shell commands
Verify model data is static and not fetched from network

telemetry_events: provider_selected: fires when user changes provider segment
model_selected: fires when user selects a different model
cli_status_checked: fires with provider and installed boolean

metrics.name: provider_switch_latency_ms
metrics.notes: Time from tap to model list update visible

metrics.name: cli_detection_latency_ms
metrics.notes: Time for async CLI detection to complete

metrics.name: provider_selection_distribution
metrics.notes: Track which providers users select most often

acceptance_tests: Given New Session Modal is open, when I tap OpenAI segment, then model list shows only OpenAI models
Given provider is Anthropic, when modal opens, then Claude Sonnet 4.5 is selected as default
Given Claude CLI is installed, when I select Anthropic, then green checkmark badge appears
Given no CLI installed for Google, when I select Google, then yellow warning badge appears with tooltip
acceptance_criteria: Provider segmented picker renders with three tappable segments
Model list updates within 50ms of provider change
Default model is auto-selected on provider change
Tier badges display with distinct colors for flagship, balanced, fast
CLI status badge reflects actual PATH availability
Selected provider and model are correctly bound to parent state

criteria: All unit tests pass for ModelRegistry and AIProvider
Integration tests verify state binding with NewSessionModal
UI renders correctly in light and dark mode
Code reviewed and approved by at least one reviewer
No SwiftUI preview crashes or warnings

completed_when: ProviderModelSection is integrated into NewSessionModal, all three providers show filtered model lists with tier badges, CLI detection works asynchronously, and selected values persist to session creation.
completed_evidence: Screenshot of New Session Modal showing provider picker with all three segments, model list with tier badges, and CLI status badge. Test run output showing all ProviderModelSectionTests passing.
status_reason: Ready for implementation after NewSessionModal base structure is in place.
open_questions: Should model descriptions be shown inline or on hover tooltip?
Should we cache CLI detection results across modal opens?
What happens if user has multiple CLI versions installed?
notes: This atom focuses on the UI component only. CLI invocation with selected model happens in A005-CREATE. Model list is static for MVP; dynamic fetching from CLI deferred.

na_justifications.metrics[2].target: Observational metric for analytics; no target threshold required - tracking distribution only

verification_steps: Run swift build and verify ProviderModelSection.swift compiles without errors
Run swift test --filter ProviderModelSectionTests and verify all tests pass
Open New Session Modal in running app and verify provider picker appears with three segments
Select each provider and verify model list updates correctly with appropriate tier badges
Verify CLI status badge shows correct installed state for at least one provider

risks: CLI detection may be slow on some systems with large PATH
Model list may grow requiring pagination or search
Tier badge colors may not be accessible for colorblind users
mitigations: Add 500ms timeout to CLI detection with fallback to unknown state
Keep model list under 10 items per provider for MVP
Add text labels alongside colors: flagship has star icon, balanced has scale icon, fast has lightning icon
risk_register.blast_radius: Affects NewSessionModal UI only; no impact on existing session functionality or data persistence
risk_register.fallback_plan: If component fails to render, catch error and show simple text picker fallback with provider and model as plain dropdowns

persistence: No direct persistence; values flow to parent modal for session creation
